title: Ankra Agent Helm chart values
description: Configuration values for the Ankra Agent chart.

nats_worker_max_workers.title: NATS worker count
nats_worker_max_workers.description: Maximum number of NATS worker threads for processing commands.

ankra_url.title: Ankra platform URL
ankra_url.description: Base URL of the Ankra platform the agent connects to.

token.title: Agent token
token.description: Ankra agent token. Leave empty when using an existing secret.

existing_secret_name.title: Existing secret name
existing_secret_name.description: Name of a pre-existing secret that holds the agent token.

secret_key.title: Existing secret key
secret_key.description: Key within the existing secret that holds the agent token.

replica_count.title: Replica count
replica_count.description: Number of agent replicas to run.

topologySpreadConstraints.title: Topology spread constraints
topologySpreadConstraints.description: Pod topology spread constraints applied to the agent pods.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.title: Termination grace period (seconds)
terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Time to wait before forcefully terminating the agent. Should not be set too low or the agent may not finish its work.

repository.title: Image repository
repository.description: Repository for the agent container image.

pull_policy.title: Image pull policy
pull_policy.description: Image pull policy for the agent container.

pull_secrets.title: Image pull secrets
pull_secrets.description: References to secrets used for pulling the image from a private registry.

tag.title: Image tag
tag.description: Image tag. Defaults to the moving 'stable' tag, or override with a specific version.

annotations.title: Service account annotations
annotations.description: Annotations to add to the service account.

name.title: Service account name
name.description: Name of the service account to use.

pod_annotations.title: Pod annotations
pod_annotations.description: Annotations to add to the agent pods.

pod_security_context.title: Pod security context
pod_security_context.description: Security context applied at the pod level.

security_context.title: Container security context
security_context.description: Security context applied at the container level.

node_port.title: Node port
node_port.description: Node port to expose when service type is NodePort. Leave empty to let Kubernetes assign one.

annotations.title: Service annotations
annotations.description: Annotations to add to the service.

resources.title: Resource requests and limits
resources.description: Compute resource requests and limits for the agent container.

node_selector.title: Node selector
node_selector.description: Node selector applied to the agent pods.

tolerations.title: Tolerations
tolerations.description: Tolerations applied to the agent pods.

affinity.title: Affinity
affinity.description: Affinity rules applied to the agent pods.

extra_env.title: Extra environment variables
extra_env.description: Additional environment variables to inject into the agent container.

nameOverride.title: Name override
nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in resource names.

fullnameOverride.title: Full name override
fullnameOverride.description: Override the fully qualified app name used in resource names.
